[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Changes to depreciation rules: the law increased the amount of assets that can be expensed under Section 179 and introduced a new bonus depreciation provision, allowing businesses to immediately deduct the full cost of certain assets.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Changes to qualified business income deduction: the law introduced a new deduction for pass-through businesses, allowing these businesses to deduct up to 20% of their qualified business income from their taxable income.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Changes to entertainment expenses: the law eliminated the deduction for entertainment expenses but retained the deduction for employee meals.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Overall, these changes could have a significant impact on small business deductions, depending on the size and type of business.
